conditions.description: the report describes a measurement host

conditions.refusal: host is virtualised (wsl); a qualification host must not run inside WSL, VirtualBox, VMware or a nested VM

conditions.description: the host booted in UEFI mode
conditions.refusal: boot mode is bios; UEFI is required
/dev/dri is absent; without KMS there is no page-flip, no vblank and no connector
no /dev/dri/renderD* node; GPU rendering cannot be measured

conditions.description: an OpenGL renderer was observed and is hardware, not a software rasteriser
conditions.refusal: renderer is llvmpipe (LLVM 22.1.8, 256 bits), a software rasteriser; it renders correctly and proves nothing about the hardware path

conditions.description: a hardware Vulkan device is present, backed by a real DRM device
conditions.observed: Microsoft Direct3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU)
conditions.refusal: Vulkan device 'Microsoft Direct3D12 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU)' is translated or emulated; a paravirtualised device name is not a hardware render path

conditions.description: at least two displays are physically connected
conditions.refusal: 0 connected output(s); 2 are required, and nested windows are not outputs
no physical TPM 2.0; an emulated TPM proves the software path, not the machine

conditions.description: the Secure Boot state was observed
conditions.refusal: Secure Boot state is unknown; it must be explicitly observed, even when disabled

conditions.description: KVM is usable: /dev/kvm exists and virt-host-validate qemu passes

conditions.refusal: xdg-desktop-portal is inactive; screen sharing and screenshots cannot be measured
Orca is not installed; accessibility cannot be measured, and labels are not Orca evidence
speech-dispatcher is not installed; spoken output cannot be captured
neither IBus nor Fcitx 5 is available; CJK input cannot be measured

conditions.observed: cryptsetup 2.8.7 flags: UDEV BLKID KEYRING FIPS KERNEL_CAPI PWQUALITY HW_OPAL

conditions.description: sufficient RAM for the guest matrices
conditions.refusal: 15.4 GiB RAM; 16 GiB is the reduced-matrix minimum

conditions.description: sufficient storage for guests, overlays and retained evidence
the evidence byte round-trip guard passes
conditions.refusal: tests/evidence did not pass; attested bytes may not round-trip this checkout
